# Set Up 
```{r} 

sites <- get_wq_sites()

study_extent <- study_area %>%
  sf::st_bbox() %>%
  sf::st_as_sfc() %>%
  sf::st_buffer(1000)

land_barrier <- sf::st_difference(
  study_extent,
  sf::st_union(study_area)
) %>%
  sf::st_as_sf()

cost_raster <- ipdw::costrasterGen(
  xymat = sites,
  pols = land_barrier,
  extent = "polys",
  projstr = sf::st_crs(study_area)$proj4string,
  resolution = 100
)



dist_pwr <- c(
  0.25,
  0.5,
  0.75,
  1,
  1.25,
  1.5,
  2,
  2.5,
  3
)

max_rng <- c(
  5000, 
  10000,  
  15000,
  20000
)

```


# Chlorophyll-a (**MAY DROP**)

```{r}

chla_test <- ipdw_sensitivity(
  chla_clean,
  cost_raster,
  n_seeds = 5,
  value_col = "mean",
  unit = "mg/L",
  dist_powers = dist_pwr,
  max_ranges = max_rng
)

chla_test

```

```{r}
chla_ipdw <- ipdw_manual(chla_clean, cost_raster, 20000, "mean", dist_power = 1)

plot(
  chla_ipdw,
  main = "Chlorophyll-a IPDW"
)

```

# Salinity (***FINALIZED****)

## Eval Sensitivity
Test model sensitivity against distance power X max range interactions
```{r}
# SAL

sal_sensitivity <- ipdw_sensitivity(
  sal_clean,
  cost_raster,
  n_seeds = 5,
  value_col = "mean",
  unit = "ppt",
  dist_powers = dist_pwr,
  max_ranges = max_rng
)

sal_sensitivity

# save distance power output for later reference
saveRDS(
  sal_sensitivity,
  file = here::here("2-data", "models", "salinity_sensitivity_test.rds")
)

```

```{r}
# create heatmap to evaluate sensitivity

ggplot(
  sal_sensitivity$summary,
  aes(
    x = factor(dist_power),
    y = factor(max_range),
    fill = mean_MAE
  )
) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", mean_MAE))) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(direction = -1) +
  labs(
    title = "Salinity IPDW Sensitivity",
    x = "Distance Power",
    y = "Maximum Range (m)",
    fill = "Mean MAE"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave("sal_sens_plot", path = here::here("4-tables-and-figures"), device = "png")

```

## Run model using tuned parameters

```{r}

sal_proc <- readRDS(here::here("2-data", "processed", "sal_proc.rds"))

set.seed(42) 

folds <- blockCV::cv_spatial(
        x = sal_proc,
        k = 5,
        size = 5000,
        selection = "random",
        plot = FALSE
      )

sal_stats <- ipdw_stats(
  sal_proc, 
  cost_raster, 
  folds = folds, 
  dist_pwr = .25, 
  max_range = 10000, 
  value_col = "mean")


sal_rast <- ipdw_manual(
  sal_proc, 
  cost_raster, 
  range = 10000, 
  "mean", 
  dist_power = 0.25
  )  

plot(
  sal_rast,
  main = "DP = 0.25, MR = 10 km",
  sub = sprintf(
    "MAE = %.3f | RMSE = %.3f | Bias = %.3f",
    sal_stats$MAE,
    sal_stats$RMSE,
    sal_stats$Bias
  )
)

```

## Save model results

```{r}
saveRDS(sal_stats, file = here::here("2-data", "models", "sal_stats.rds"))
saveRDS(sal_rast, file = here::here("2-data", "models", "sal_rast.rds"))

```

```{r}
library(patchwork)

# Reusable heatmap function
plot_sensitivity <- function(data, parameter) {

  data <- data %>%
    mutate(
      dist_power = factor(
        dist_power,
        levels = sort(unique(dist_power))
      ),
      max_range = factor(
        max_range,
        levels = sort(unique(max_range))
      )
    )

  ggplot(
    data,
    aes(
      x = dist_power,
      y = max_range,
      fill = mean_MAE
    )
  ) +
    geom_tile() +
    geom_text(
      aes(
        label = sprintf("%.2f", mean_MAE),
        color = mean_MAE > median(mean_MAE, na.rm = TRUE)
      ),
      size = 3
    ) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(
      option = "viridis",
      direction = -1,
      name = "Mean MAE"
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("FALSE" = "black", "TRUE" = "white"),
      guide = "none"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = parameter,
      x = "Distance Power",
      y = "Maximum Range (m)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 12,
        hjust = 0.5
      ),
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 45,
        hjust = 1
      ),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
}

# Generate individual plots
p_do <- plot_sensitivity(
  do_sensitivity$summary,
  "Dissolved Oxygen"
)

p_sal <- plot_sensitivity(
  sal_sensitivity$summary,
  "Salinity"
)

p_turb <- plot_sensitivity(
  turb_sensitivity$summary,
  "Turbidity"
)

p_temp <- plot_sensitivity(
  water_temp_sensitivity$summary,
  "Water Temperature"
)

# Combine using patchwork
sensitivity_plot <-
  (p_do | p_sal) /
  (p_turb | p_temp) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "IPDW Parameter Sensitivity Analysis",
    subtitle = "Mean MAE from 5-fold spatial cross-validation",
    caption = paste(
      "Red outlines indicate the lowest MAE",
      "for each environmental parameter."
    )
  )

# Display
sensitivity_plot

# Export for capstone
ggsave(
  "4-tables-and-figures/ipdw-sensitivity.png",
  plot = sensitivity_plot,
  width = 14,
  height = 9,
  dpi = 300
)

```
